content:
{D}Oh, the summer{G}time is {D}coming and the {G}leaves are sweetly {D}blooming,
and the {G}wild {A}mountain {h}thyme grows ar{G}ound the bloomin' heather
Will ye {D}go, {G}lassie, {D}go.

And we'll {G}all go to{D}gether to pluck {G}wild {A}mountain {h}thyme, 
all ar{G}ound the bloomin' heather Will ye {D}go, {G}lassie, {D}go.

I will build my love a bower by yon pure crystal fountain,
and round it I will pile all the flowers o' the mountain,
Will yo go, lassie, go.

If my true love she'll not come then I'll surely find another
to pull wild mountain thyme all around the bloomin' heather
Will ye go, lassie, go.
title: Wild Mountain Thyme
